title: brachypodium loliaceum
intro: Brachypodium loliaceum, commonly known as False Brome, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the grass family Poaceae. It is used in traditional medicine to promote digestive health and alleviate symptoms of gastrointestinal issues such as constipation and diarrhea. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce inflammation, and modulate gut bacteria. The bioactive constituents of B. loliaceum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
